verses.original: הַדָּבָ֛ר אֲשֶׁר־ הָיָ֥ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה בִּימֵ֨י יְהוֹיָקִ֧ים בֶּן־ יֹאשִׁיָּ֛הוּ מֶ֥לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- hā·yāh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū mê·’êṯ Yah·weh bî·mê yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ben- yō·šî·yā·hū me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah . . .
verses.literalPt: A palavra que da parte de Jeová veio a Jeremias nos dias de Jeoaquim, filho de Josias, rei de Judá, dizendo:

verses.original: הָלוֹךְ֮ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית הָרֵכָבִים֒ וְדִבַּרְתָּ֣ אוֹתָ֔ם וַהֲבִֽאוֹתָם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ אַחַ֖ת הַלְּשָׁכ֑וֹת וְהִשְׁקִיתָ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם יָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: hā·lō·wḵ ’el- bêṯ hā·rê·ḵā·ḇîm wə·ḏib·bar·tā ’ō·w·ṯām wa·hă·ḇi·’ō·w·ṯām bêṯ Yah·weh ’el- ’a·ḥaṯ hal·lə·šā·ḵō·wṯ wə·hiš·qî·ṯā ’ō·w·ṯām yā·yin
verses.literal: Go to the house of the Rechabites speak to them and bring them to one of the chambers of the house of the LORD to offer them a drink of wine
verses.literalPt: Vai à casa dos recabitas, fala com eles e, introduzindo-os na casa de Jeová, em uma das câmaras, dá-lhes vinho a beber.

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֞ח אֶת־ יַאֲזַנְיָ֤ה בֶֽן־ יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ חֲבַצִּנְיָ֔ה וְאֶת־ אֶחָ֖יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית הָרֵכָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ya·’ă·zan·yāh ḇen- yir·mə·yā·hū ben- ḥă·ḇaṣ·ṣin·yāh wə·’eṯ- ’e·ḥāw wə·’eṯ- kāl- bā·nāw wə·’êṯ kāl- bêṯ hā·rê·ḵā·ḇîm
verses.literal: So I took Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah the son of Habazziniah and his brothers and all his sons the entire house of the Rechabites
verses.literalPt: Tomei a Jazanias, filho de Jeremias, filho de Habazinias, e a seus irmãos e a todos os seus filhos e a toda a casa dos recabitas;

verses.original: וָאָבִ֤א אֹתָם֙ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ לִשְׁכַּ֗ת בְּנֵ֛י חָנָ֥ן בֶּן־ יִגְדַּלְיָ֖הוּ אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־ אֵ֙צֶל֙ לִשְׁכַּ֣ת הַשָּׂרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר מִמַּ֗עַל לְלִשְׁכַּ֛ת מַעֲשֵׂיָ֥הוּ בֶן־ שַׁלֻּ֖ם שֹׁמֵ֥ר הַסַּֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ā·ḇi ’ō·ṯām bêṯ Yah·weh ’el- liš·kaṯ bə·nê ḥā·nān ben- yiḡ·dal·yā·hū ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- ’ê·ṣel liš·kaṯ haś·śā·rîm ’ă·šer mim·ma·‘al lə·liš·kaṯ ma·‘ă·śê·yā·hū ḇen- šal·lum šō·mêr has·sap̄
verses.literal: and I brought them into the house of the LORD to a chamber occupied by the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah a man of God This room was near the chamber of the officials which was above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum the doorkeeper . . .
verses.literalPt: e os introduzi na casa de Jeová, na câmara dos filhos de Hanã, filho de Jigdalias, homem de Deus, a qual estava junto à câmara dos príncipes, e ficava sobre a câmara de Maaseias, filho de Salum, guarda do vestíbulo;

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֣י׀ בְּנֵ֣י בֵית־ הָרֵכָבִ֗ים גְּבִעִ֛ים מְלֵאִ֥ים יַ֖יִן וְכֹס֑וֹת וָאֹמַ֥ר אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם שְׁתוּ־ יָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên lip̄·nê bə·nê ḇêṯ- hā·rê·ḵā·ḇîm gə·ḇi·‘îm mə·lê·’îm ya·yin wə·ḵō·sō·wṯ wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·hem šə·ṯū- yā·yin
verses.literal: Then I set pitchers full of wine and some cups before the men of the house of the Rechabites and I said to them Drink some wine
verses.literalPt: e pus diante dos filhos da casa dos recabitas taças cheias de vinho, e copos, e disse-lhes: Bebei vinho.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נִשְׁתֶּה־ יָּ֑יִן כִּי֩ יוֹנָדָ֨ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֜ב אָבִ֗ינוּ צִוָּ֤ה עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹ֧א תִשְׁתּוּ־ יַ֛יִן אַתֶּ֥ם וּבְנֵיכֶ֖ם עַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū lō niš·teh- yā·yin kî yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ ’ā·ḇî·nū ṣiw·wāh ‘ā·lê·nū lê·mōr lō ṯiš·tū- ya·yin ’at·tem ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem ‘aḏ- ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: We do not drink wine they replied for our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab commanded us . . . Neither you nor your descendants are ever to . . . . . . drink wine
verses.literalPt: Eles, porém, responderam: Não beberemos vinho, porque Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, nosso pai, nos ordenou, dizendo: Não bebereis vinho, nem vós, nem vossos filhos, nunca jamais;

verses.original: וּבַ֣יִת לֹֽא־ תִבְנ֗וּ וְזֶ֤רַע לֹֽא־ תִזְרָ֙עוּ֙ וְכֶ֣רֶם לֹֽא־ תִטָּ֔עוּ וְלֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לָכֶ֑ם כִּ֠י בָּאֳהָלִ֤ים תֵּֽשְׁבוּ֙ כָּל־ יְמֵיכֶ֔ם לְמַ֨עַן תִּֽחְי֜וּ יָמִ֤ים רַבִּים֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הָאֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם גָּרִ֥ים שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·yiṯ lō- ṯiḇ·nū wə·ze·ra‘ lō- ṯiz·rā·‘ū wə·ḵe·rem lō- ṯiṭ·ṭā·‘ū wə·lō yih·yeh lā·ḵem kî bā·’o·hā·lîm tê·šə·ḇū kāl- yə·mê·ḵem lə·ma·‘an tiḥ·yū yā·mîm rab·bîm ‘al- pə·nê hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer ’at·tem gā·rîm šām
verses.literal: Nor are you ever to build a house or sow seed or plant a vineyard Those things are not for you Instead you must live in tents all your lives so that you may live a long time in . . . the land where you wander . . .
verses.literalPt: não edificareis casa, nem semeareis semente, nem plantareis vinha, nem a possuireis; mas habitareis em tendas todos os vossos dias, para que vivais muitos dias sobre a face da terra, em que vós sois peregrinos.

verses.original: וַנִּשְׁמַ֗ע בְּק֨וֹל יְהוֹנָדָ֤ב בֶּן־ רֵכָב֙ אָבִ֔ינוּ לְכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑נוּ לְבִלְתִּ֤י שְׁתֽוֹת־ יַ֙יִן֙ כָּל־ יָמֵ֔ינוּ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ נָשֵׁ֔ינוּ בָּנֵ֖ינוּ וּבְנֹתֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·niš·ma‘ bə·qō·wl yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ ’ā·ḇî·nū lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wā·nū lə·ḇil·tî šə·ṯō·wṯ- ya·yin kāl- yā·mê·nū ’ă·naḥ·nū nā·šê·nū bā·nê·nū ū·ḇə·nō·ṯê·nū
verses.literal: And we have obeyed the voice of our forefather Jonadab son of Rechab in all he commanded us So we have not drunk wine all our lives neither we nor our wives nor our sons and daughters
verses.literalPt: Temos obedecido à voz de Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, nosso pai, em toda a palavra que nos ordenou, de não bebermos vinho em todos os nossos dias, nós, nossas mulheres, nossos filhos e nossas filhas;

verses.original: וּלְבִלְתִּ֛י בְּנ֥וֹת בָּתִּ֖ים לְשִׁבְתֵּ֑נוּ וְכֶ֧רֶם וְשָׂדֶ֛ה וָזֶ֖רַע לֹ֥א יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇil·tî bə·nō·wṯ bāt·tîm lə·šiḇ·tê·nū wə·ḵe·rem wə·śā·ḏeh wā·ze·ra‘ lō yih·yeh- lā·nū
verses.literal: Nor have we built houses in which to live and we have not owned any vineyards or fields or crops
verses.literalPt: nem de edificarmos casas para nossa moradia; nem de possuirmos vinha, nem campo, nem semente;

verses.original: וַנֵּ֖שֶׁב בָּֽאֳהָלִ֑ים וַנִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַנַּ֔עַשׂ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖נוּ יוֹנָדָ֥ב אָבִֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nê·šeḇ bā·’o·hā·lîm wan·niš·ma‘ wan·na·‘aś kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wā·nū yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ’ā·ḇî·nū
verses.literal: But we have lived in tents and have obeyed and done exactly as our forefather Jonadab commanded us
verses.literalPt: mas temos habitado em tendas, e temos obedecido e feito segundo tudo o que Jonadabe, nosso pai, nos ordenou.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בַּעֲל֨וֹת נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֮ אֶל־ הָאָרֶץ֒ וַנֹּ֗אמֶר בֹּ֚אוּ וְנָב֣וֹא יְרוּשָׁלִַ֔ם מִפְּנֵי֙ חֵ֣יל הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וּמִפְּנֵ֖י חֵ֣יל אֲרָ֑ם וַנֵּ֖שֶׁב בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba·‘ă·lō·wṯ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ wan·nō·mer bō·’ū wə·nā·ḇō·w yə·rū·šā·lim mip·pə·nê ḥêl hak·kaś·dîm ū·mip·pə·nê ḥêl ’ă·rām wan·nê·šeḇ bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: So when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon marched into the land we said Come let us go into Jerusalem to escape the armies of the Chaldeans . . . . . . and the Arameans So we have remained in Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: Quando, porém, Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, subia à nossa terra, dissemos: Vinde, e vamo-nos a Jerusalém por causa do exército dos caldeus, e por causa do exército dos siros; assim habitamos em Jerusalém.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah . . .
verses.literalPt: Veio a palavra de Jeová a Jeremias, dizendo:

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הָלֹ֤ךְ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ לְאִ֣ישׁ יְהוּדָ֔ה וּלְיֽוֹשְׁבֵ֖י יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲל֨וֹא תִקְח֥וּ מוּסָ֛ר לִשְׁמֹ֥עַ אֶל־ דְּבָרַ֖י נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hā·lōḵ wə·’ā·mar·tā lə·’îš yə·hū·ḏāh ū·lə·yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim hă·lō·w ṯiq·ḥū mū·sār liš·mō·a‘ ’el- də·ḇā·ray nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Go and tell the men of Judah and the residents of Jerusalem Will you not accept discipline and obey . . . My words declares the LORD
verses.literalPt: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Vai, e dize aos homens de Judá e aos habitantes de Jerusalém: Acaso não recebereis instrução para ouvirdes as minhas palavras? diz Jeová.

verses.original: הוּקַ֡ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן־ רֵ֠כָב אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה אֶת־ בָּנָ֜יו לְבִלְתִּ֣י שְׁתֽוֹת־ יַ֗יִן וְלֹ֤א שָׁתוּ֙ עַד־ הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּ֣י שָֽׁמְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת מִצְוַ֣ת אֲבִיהֶ֑ם וְאָ֨נֹכִ֜י דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶם֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ם וְדַבֵּ֔ר וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hū·qam ’eṯ- diḇ·rê yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ- bā·nāw lə·ḇil·tî šə·ṯō·wṯ- ya·yin wə·lō šā·ṯū ‘aḏ- hay·yō·wm haz·zeh kî šā·mə·‘ū ’êṯ miṣ·waṯ ’ă·ḇî·hem wə·’ā·nō·ḵî dib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem haš·kêm wə·ḏab·bêr wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: The words of Jonadab son of Rechab have been carried out He commanded his sons not to drink wine and they have not drunk it to this very day because they have obeyed the command of their forefather But I have spoken to you again and again . . . and you have not obeyed Me . . .
verses.literalPt: Guardadas têm sido as palavras de Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, pelas quais ordenou a seus filhos que não bebessem vinho; e até o dia de hoje não o têm bebido, porque obedecem ao mandamento de seu pai; eu, porém, vos tenho falado a vós, levantando-me cedo e falando, e não me tendes escutado.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֣ח אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אֶת־ כָּל־ עֲבָדַ֣י הַנְּבִאִ֣ים׀ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ים וְשָׁלֹ֣חַ׀ לֵאמֹ֡ר שֻׁבוּ־ נָ֡א אִישׁ֩ מִדַּרְכּ֨וֹ הָרָעָ֜ה וְהֵיטִ֣יבוּ מַֽעַלְלֵיכֶ֗ם וְאַל־ תֵּ֨לְכ֜וּ אַחֲרֵ֨י אֱלֹהִ֤ים אֲחֵרִים֙ לְעָבְדָ֔ם וּשְׁבוּ֙ אֶל־ הָ֣אֲדָמָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥תִּי לָכֶ֖ם וְלַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְלֹ֤א הִטִּיתֶם֙ אֶֽת־ אָזְנְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·laḥ ’ă·lê·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay han·nə·ḇi·’îm haš·kêm wə·šā·lō·aḥ lê·mōr šu·ḇū- nā ’îš mid·dar·kōw hā·rā·‘āh wə·hê·ṭî·ḇū ma·‘al·lê·ḵem wə·’al- tê·lə·ḵū ’a·ḥă·rê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm lə·‘ā·ḇə·ḏām ū·šə·ḇū ’el- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer- nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem wə·la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wə·lō hiṭ·ṭî·ṯem ’eṯ- ’ā·zə·nə·ḵem wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: Again and again I have sent you all My servants the prophets proclaiming Turn now each of you from your wicked ways and correct your actions Do not go after . . . other gods to serve them Live in the land that I have given to you and your fathers But you have not inclined your ear or listened to Me
verses.literalPt: Também vos tenho enviado a vós todos os meus servos, os profetas, levantando-me cedo e enviando-os, a dizer: Tornai-vos agora, cada um do seu mau caminho, e emendai os vossos feitos, e não vades após outros deuses para os servirdes, e habitareis na terra que vos dei a vós e a vossos pais; porém não inclinastes os vossos ouvidos, nem me escutastes.

verses.original: כִּ֣י הֵקִ֗ימוּ בְּנֵי֙ יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֔ב אֶת־ מִצְוַ֥ת אֲבִיהֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֑ם וְהָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה לֹ֥א שָׁמְע֖וּ אֵלָֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî hê·qî·mū bə·nê yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ ’eṯ- miṣ·waṯ ’ă·ḇî·hem ’ă·šer ṣiw·wām wə·hā·‘ām haz·zeh lō šā·mə·‘ū ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: Yes the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab carried out the command their forefather gave them but these people have not listened to Me
verses.literalPt: Porquanto os filhos de Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, têm guardado o mandamento de seu pai, que lhes ordenou, mas este povo não tem escutado;

verses.original: לָ֠כֵן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הִנְנִ֧י מֵבִ֣יא אֶל־ יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶ֤ל כָּל־ יֽוֹשְׁבֵי֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־ הָ֣רָעָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם יַ֣עַן דִּבַּ֤רְתִּי אֲלֵיהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א שָׁמֵ֔עוּ וָאֶקְרָ֥א לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א עָנֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl hin·nî mê·ḇî ’el- yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’el kāl- yō·wō·šə·ḇê yə·rū·šā·lim ’êṯ kāl- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer dib·bar·tî ‘ă·lê·hem ya·‘an dib·bar·tî ’ă·lê·hem wə·lō šā·mê·‘ū wā·’eq·rā lā·hem wə·lō ‘ā·nū
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts the God of Israel says Behold I will bring to Judah and to all the residents of Jerusalem all the disaster I have pronounced against them because I have spoken to them but they have not obeyed and I have called to them but they have not answered
verses.literalPt: portanto assim diz Jeová, Deus dos exércitos, Deus de Israel: Eis que trarei sobre Judá e sobre todos os habitantes de Jerusalém todo o mal que pronunciei contra eles: porque lhes falei, porém não me ouviram; chamei-os, porém não responderam.

verses.original: וּלְבֵ֨ית הָרֵכָבִ֜ים אָמַ֣ר יִרְמְיָ֗הוּ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר שְׁמַעְתֶּ֔ם עַל־ מִצְוַ֖ת יְהוֹנָדָ֣ב אֲבִיכֶ֑ם וַֽתִּשְׁמְרוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ מִצְוֺתָ֔יו וַֽתַּעֲשׂ֔וּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖ה אֶתְכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḇêṯ hā·rê·ḵā·ḇîm ’ā·mar yir·mə·yā·hū kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl ya·‘an ’ă·šer šə·ma‘·tem ‘al- miṣ·waṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ’ă·ḇî·ḵem wat·tiš·mə·rū ’eṯ- kāl- miṣ·wō·ṯāw wat·ta·‘ă·śū kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah said to the house of the Rechabites This is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Because you have obeyed . . . the command of your forefather Jonadab and have kept all his commandments and have done all that he charged you to do
verses.literalPt: À casa dos recabitas disse Jeremias: Assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: Porque haveis obedecido o mandamento de Jonadabe, vosso pai, guardando todos os seus preceitos, e fazendo segundo tudo o que vos ordenou;

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לֹֽא־ יִכָּרֵ֨ת אִ֜ישׁ לְיוֹנָדָ֧ב בֶּן־ רֵכָ֛ב עֹמֵ֥ד לְפָנַ֖י כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl lō- yik·kā·rêṯ ’îš lə·yō·w·nā·ḏāḇ ben- rê·ḵāḇ ‘ō·mêḏ lə·p̄ā·nay kāl- hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: this is what the LORD of Hosts the God of Israel says Jonadab son of Rechab will never . . . fail to have a man . . . to stand before Me
verses.literalPt: portanto assim diz Jeová dos Exércitos, Deus de Israel: A Jonadabe, filho de Recabe, não lhe faltará nunca varão que assista diante de mim para sempre.
